verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents three kinds of reports on completed transactions and itemized exports with a line-item tax breakdown for every transaction. It reports tax even on payments processed outside Stripe, and integrates with TaxJar for US filing, which together give accountants filing-ready transaction detail. The evidence does not show a real-time liability view by jurisdiction or a collected-versus-owed comparison, so the core 'see liability at any moment' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit jurisdiction-level liability summaries, a collected-vs-owed comparison, real-time views, GL-ready export formats, and independent corroboration of report quality.
